title: India’s Only Active Volcano, Mysterious Mud Volcanoes and a Forgotten Ancient City – 3 Sites Added to UNESCO’s Tentative List
description: India has added three sites to UNESCO’s Tentative List: Baratang’s mud volcanoes and limestone caves, Andaman’s volcanic islands and Sirpur’s ancient temples in Chhattisgarh. title: Giant Jurassic fossil sheds light on the evolution of a six-legged predator
description: Insects belong to a broader group of six-legged animals called hexapods. This group also includes other less well-known, small animals, including diplurans or two-pronged bristletails, wingless relatives of insects with two rear projections called cerci that resemble feelers or pincers.
